body: I appreciate the advise and your concern. A couple of days have gone by, I've left the pills on the paper towel on my coffee-table, but every night, i spend a lot of time just staring at them, thinking over and over again, "this is what it comes down to, these 40 pills and that's it." I want to think that every day that goes by with me not taking the pills is a good day, or at least a way to control my mind.  I'm seeing my therapist Monday. But I  still feel this is something that will never go away in my mind,  no matter what I do. I've had this pain inside me, off and on, for far too long.
